title: Tool a job can call
description: The contents of tools/<name>/tool.yml. Rules that need more than this file (the folder name, the limits inside the argument schema, the upstream's operations, map.ts) are enforced by flax agents check.

name.description: Must equal the tool's folder name. Jobs list tools by this name.

description.description: What the model is told the tool does. Written here, never copied from the upstream.

arguments.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the arguments: an object with no additional properties, and a limit on every value.

upstream.description: The system the tool reads from, and the only operations it may call there.

source.description: untrusted: results can carry text anyone can write (pull request and issue bodies, Slack messages, log lines, web pages); trusted: only text a person reviewed before it landed, or that our own systems wrote. Every result carries this tag, and a run records whether its model saw untrusted text.

result_max_bytes.description: Largest result, in bytes of UTF-8, the model gets; longer results are cut.
